signals.label: Manager flow
signals.desc: Net adds/initiations minus trims/exits by skilled active ETFs since last week (drift-adjusted, skill-weighted)

signals.label: Fwd EPS growth
signals.desc: Consensus EPS growth, next fiscal year (Yahoo, daily)

signals.label: Analyst agreement
signals.desc: Narrow range of analysts' next-year EPS estimates scores higher (Diether, Malloy & Scherbina 2002)

signals.label: Beat size
signals.desc: Average EPS surprise over the last 4 quarters (capped at 50%), blended with a standardized surprise (average beat / its variability)

signals.label: Beat consistency
signals.desc: Share of last 4 quarters that beat consensus

signals.label: Estimate revisions
signals.desc: 30-day change in consensus EPS (current and next fiscal year, Yahoo)

signals.label: Growth acceleration
signals.desc: Next-year EPS growth minus this year's: is growth speeding up?

signals.label: Sales strength
signals.desc: Consensus revenue growth next year, blended with the average revenue beat over 4 quarters

signals.label: Market reaction
signals.desc: Average 2-day move vs SPY after the last 4 reports: did the market believe the beat?

signals.label: Guidance
signals.desc: Raised / maintained / lowered guidance at the last report, adjusted for guide vs consensus

signals.label: Best-ideas overlap
signals.desc: Distinct managers holding it as one of a fund's 15 largest positions (most = 100); managers that have not beaten their benchmark count at half

signals.label: Active weight
signals.desc: Average weight above the benchmark (an active bet, not index beta)

signals.label: Momentum 12-1
signals.desc: 12-month price return excluding the latest month

signals.label: Gross profitability
signals.desc: Trailing-12-month gross profit / total assets (Novy-Marx 2013; SEC filings)

signals.label: Earnings quality
signals.desc: Low accruals: net income backed by operating cash flow, scaled by assets (Sloan 1996; SEC filings)

signals.label: Net share issuance
signals.desc: Share count shrinking (buybacks) scores higher, dilution lower (Pontiff & Woodgate 2008; SEC filings)

signals.label: Short interest
signals.desc: Lower short interest and falling short interest score higher

signals.label: Insider buying
signals.desc: Distinct insiders making open-market purchases in the last 90 days (SEC Form 4, code P); 3 or more = full score

signals.label: Asset growth
signals.desc: Slower balance-sheet growth scores higher (Cooper, Gulen & Schill 2008; off: weak lately)

signals.label: Filing changes
signals.desc: Latest 10-K/10-Q worded much like a year earlier scores higher; big rewrites score lower (Cohen, Malloy & Nguyen 2020)

signals.label: Options skew
signals.desc: Cheap downside protection (low put skew) scores higher (Xing, Zhang & Zhao 2010)

signals.label: Customer momentum
signals.desc: Main customers' last-month return and capital-spending growth, for suppliers (Cohen & Frazzini 2008)

signals.label: Low volatility
signals.desc: Lower idiosyncratic volatility scores higher (Ang, Hodrick, Xing & Zhang 2006)

signals.label: Valuation
signals.desc: Forward P/E relative to growth (PEG) and free-cash-flow yield (off)

signals.label: Structural theme
signals.desc: Tailwind score (0-3) from themes.csv (off: shown on the board, not scored)

signals.label: Quality
signals.desc: Retired: replaced by gross profitability, accruals and issuance

signals.label: Beta
signals.desc: Beta 1.0 or below scores 100, falling to 0 at beta 2.0 (off)

signals.label: Analyst drift
signals.desc: Change in mean price target over 3 months (off: targets follow prices)
